description: The control of REQ-INT-119's second criterion (R-1008 (4), the clock-only control kept), on the same fresh ladder, floor, fit and thresholds as landing_floor.json: the clamp with no retakes, the clock set to the boundary alone over the overshot state (what R-998 forbids), whose error is of order η² in every interval, so the order fitted above the round-off floor must fall below 3.0 and read as a landing defect, and the gate must fail it.
